name: kthwzz-needs-you-row-options
goal: Needs-you rows on Hub, Mac and iPhone show the 2-4 options (recommended first) plus Other; a tap records the tracker answer by Daniel, including from Hub web with the Mac Home upload off

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Hub, Mac and iPhone needs-you rows show only the question; expected 2-4 option buttons (recommended first) + Other that record the answer

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: hub-home-needs-you.spec.ts and mac-tracker-inbox.spec.ts asserted ZERO option controls on the overview (25 Nov layout rule), and every Hub tap test used a faked POST /api/hub-home/chat, so no scenario covered a Home that comes only from a linked Mac with the upload off. Reuse change: those specs now require row buttons; linked-computers-fixture offers homeChat
